To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
blue light is more efficient than red in inducing stomatal opening in the presence of anoxia.
stomatal opening in response to blue light occurs in anoxia and that this effect is oxygen dependent.

(1) stomatal opening is induced by light in anoxically treated maize leaves, (2) this effect depends on light quality and is stronger under blue light than red light, (3) this blue light-dependent effect requires the presence of oxygen, (4) anoxia inhibits light-induced stomatal opening, and (5) the effect is reversible.
